title: IncuBrix AI Social Automation

copy.headline: Automate Your Social Growth
copy.support: Generate, schedule, and amplify viral posts across every channel on autopilot.

concept: A futuristic fusion of a dynamic megaphone booster engine launching glowing orbital campaign rings. High-energy tech aesthetic with neon electric accents on deep midnight blue, projecting power, automation, and effortless viral momentum.

design_system.style: Vibrant 3D-inspired vector with volumetric gradients, glowing edge rim-lights, and bold geometric conduits
design_system.lighting: Intense top-left electric cyan rim light with soft neon pink back-glow from the propulsion nozzle

composition.hero: A central sleek isometric turbo-megaphone booster angled at 35 degrees pointing up-right: glossy deep indigo fuselage (1E1B4B) with bright cyan glowing seams (06B6D4), an oversized flared sound cone radiating concentric holographic sound rings in translucent gradient cyan to magenta, and twin miniature intake thrusters firing bright coral exhaust flames (F43F5E). Four rounded translucent glass orbit nodes float along a luminous ribbon around the megaphone nozzle, symbolizing content workflow.
props: Four-point neon sparkle stars floating in the upper-right corner
Holographic hashtag chip 'TRENDING' glowing softly at top-left of the hero
Translucent calendar schedule badge hovering at bottom-left
Floating mini heart and share indicator orbs in coral and cyan drifting from the thruster blast
Subtle glowing geometric particle dust surrounding the sound waves
composition.background: Deep radial gradient from glowing indigo (1E1B4B) at center to dark obsidian (0D0E1A) at the outer borders with faint digital grid lines fading into the perimeter
decor: Large faint concentric circular soundwaves in 5% opacity cyan
Sweeping angled speed-lines cutting across the bottom-right corner
Subtle dotted matrix constellation pattern in the upper half
